title: State in vendor/README.md that vendored versions follow the release sequence, not upstream

source.anchor: Directory names and upstream version numbers are deliberately unchanged, so the manifest below still reads as an upstream snapshot.

task:
Problem: vendor/README.md:5 states "Directory names and upstream version numbers are deliberately unchanged, so the manifest below still reads as an upstream snapshot", and the manifest table at vendor/README.md:13-23 has a `Version` column reading 1.8.1, 3.18.0, 4.0.0-rc.7, 1.0.0-rc.5, 1.0.4, 1.0.0, 1.1.2, 1.0.15 and 1.0.0. Every vendored package.json now carries a different version: vendor/cosmokit 1.8.2, vendor/schemastery 3.18.1, vendor/cordis 4.0.1, vendor/loader 1.0.2, vendor/include 1.0.6, vendor/group 1.0.1, vendor/timer 1.1.3, vendor/hmr 1.0.16, vendor/logger-console 1.0.1 (`for d in vendor/*/package.json; do node -e "console.log('$d', require('./$d').version)"; done`). That is by design: .agents/notes/implemented/process/2026-08-10-npm-release-sequences.md:37-39 gives the nine vendored packages their own version lines under `pnpm run release:vendor` ("the published version is the higher of the manifest version and the last published version, with the patch incremented"), so the manifest field is the `@deepseek-ai` release version and only the table records the upstream version at the pinned commit. The README sentence contradicts the release note, and the sync procedure at vendor/README.md:59 ("Update the version and commit hash in the manifest table") does not say which version a maintainer writes there.

Required: rewrite the sentence at vendor/README.md:5 to state that directory names and the dependency ranges are unchanged, that the table's version is the upstream version at the pinned commit, and that each vendored package.json carries its own `@deepseek-ai` release version owned by `pnpm run release:vendor` (link the release-sequences note); rename the table column to `Upstream version`; make step 4 of the sync procedure say the upstream version and commit hash. Change no table row values and no other section.

Constraints: documentation only, no change under vendor/*/; vendor/README.md has no Chinese counterpart and is outside the pairing scope; mechanical clarification of an existing decision, no new Agent Note. The queue's mandatory coverage run names dsh-app-boot, the heaviest in-repository consumer of the vendored Loader, Include and HMR packages; it guards that package, not this edit, and passes before and after.

acceptance.run: ! grep -q 'upstream version numbers are deliberately unchanged' vendor/README.md
